triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: A completed dispatch can be reassigned through a role-aware fresh-context command that creates a new linked dispatch, renders the requested worker role and prompt path, and avoids any full-history inheritance claim.
acceptanceBindings.note: Binds the user-visible worker reassignment claim to role-aware command behavior, summary-only fresh-context prompt wording, lineage/regression coverage, and process-fact registration.

note: ProofStory contract for role-aware fresh-context worker reassignment. No milestone ledger is needed because this is a single deliverable below the configured milestone threshold.
